records.title: Clamped Masked Temporal Pooling (CMTP)
records.independent_classification_reason: Dossier contains full Python implementation, exact incident BUG-MINILM-01 with commit diff, mathematical explanation, and unit test logic. Requires isolated runtime verification to transition to verified pattern.
records.technical_problem: Division by zero and NaN propagation when pooling token embeddings on empty or fully masked sequences.
records.demonstrated_root_cause: Zero-length sequence attention mask sum is 0.0; unmasked sum / 0.0 yields IEEE 754 NaN or Inf.
records.why_it_works: Clamping divisor to max(sum_mask, 1e-9) ensures finite denominator without altering non-zero values.
records.negative_constraints: Never omit epsilon clamping on sequence denominators; never perform unmasked mean pooling.
records.cross_repo_applicability: HIGH (Applies universally to all PyTorch, ONNX, and LibTorch transformer pooling layers).
records.trade_offs_limitations: Adds negligible clamping comparison overhead (approx 10^-6 seconds).

records.title: Metric Hypersphere Unit Projection (MHUP)
records.independent_classification_reason: Dossier contains verified code snippet enforce_hypersphere_projection, mathematical proof of cosine equivalence, and test_unit_hypersphere_invariant. Ready for runtime verification.
records.technical_problem: Magnitude variation in raw embeddings skews nearest-neighbor vector retrieval towards long sentences.
records.demonstrated_root_cause: Unnormalized dot product includes both vector length and directional angle; length confounds semantic similarity.
records.why_it_works: Euclidean L2 normalization maps vectors to unit sphere where dot product exactly equals cosine similarity.
records.negative_constraints: Never evaluate raw unnormalized embeddings in inner-product cosine indexers.
records.cross_repo_applicability: HIGH (Standard across all dual-encoder and dense retrieval architectures).
records.trade_offs_limitations: Discards vector magnitude information, preventing length-based scoring heuristics.

records.title: Zero-Copy Low-Bit Computation
records.independent_classification_reason: CUDA C++ implementation dequant_trit_2bit with constant memory LUT table exists in dossier. Verified as static architectural pattern; runtime execution requires GPU or CPU emulation fixture.
records.technical_problem: Dequantizing ternary weights into FP16 causes buffer inflation and memory bandwidth bottlenecks; naive if/else causes GPU branch divergence.
records.demonstrated_root_cause: Warp-level divergence when neighboring CUDA threads evaluate non-uniform ternary values.
records.why_it_works: Constant memory LUT lookup is O(1) without conditional jumps, maintaining uniform warp execution.
records.negative_constraints: Never use if/else branching inside inner GEMM dequantization loops.
records.cross_repo_applicability: HIGH (Applies to all sub-4-bit and ternary quantized inference engines).
records.trade_offs_limitations: Limited to architectures where LUT cache latency is lower than instruction throughput.

records.title: Modality Decoupling for Independent Quantization
records.independent_classification_reason: Dossier only has a 2-sentence architectural note describing vision tower shipped as Q8_0 mmproj pack. Lacks line-by-line code diff, dataflow implementation, or automated unit test in local dossier.
records.technical_problem: Applying aggressive low-bit ternary quantization to vision encoders degrades feature extraction fidelity.
records.demonstrated_root_cause: Vision encoders exhibit higher outlier sensitivity than dense language transformer blocks.
records.why_it_works: Decoupling allows language tower to run at 1.58 bits while vision tower runs at Q8_0.
records.trade_offs_limitations: Requires managing two separate weight formats and runtime loaders.

records.title: Binary Artifact Versioning & Format Compatibility Invariant
records.independent_classification_reason: Dossier documents Incident BUG-QWENIMG-03 where missing DiT metadata headers caused loader segfaults in GGUF. Invariant supported by incident evidence.
records.technical_problem: Distributing binary model weights without architecture metadata headers causes silent loader failures or out-of-bounds memory mapping.
records.demonstrated_root_cause: Incompatible tensor layout loaded blindly based solely on file extension.
records.why_it_works: Enforcing magic bytes (GGUF) and schema version tags validates compatibility before kernel dispatch.
records.negative_constraints: Never allocate tensor buffers from binary files without validating magic bytes and version headers.
records.cross_repo_applicability: UNIVERSAL (Applies to all binary weight serialization protocols).
records.trade_offs_limitations: Requires file parsing overhead of 8-16 bytes prior to memory mapping.

records.title: Memory Footprint vs. Quality Trade-off Documentation Invariant
records.independent_classification_reason: Title represents good documentation practice cited in model card, but local dossier lacks programmatic implementation or code diff.
records.technical_problem: Users deploy inappropriate quantization levels without understanding memory/perplexity tradeoffs.
records.demonstrated_root_cause: Documentation gap between raw parameter count and runtime VRAM allocation.
records.why_it_works: Publishing empirical VRAM and benchmark tables informs deployment sizing.
records.trade_offs_limitations: Documentation can become stale without CI benchmark automation.

records.title: Format-Specific Optimization Invariant
records.independent_classification_reason: High-level synthesis concept; dossier does not contain a discrete isolated code patch for this specific title.
records.technical_problem: Applying generic quantization parameters across diverse hardware backends (Metal vs CUDA vs CPU).
records.demonstrated_root_cause: Memory architectures differ in optimal SIMD block size (e.g. 32 vs 256).
records.why_it_works: Tailoring block sizes to architecture cache line widths maximizes bandwidth utilization.
records.trade_offs_limitations: Increases build complexity by producing multiple distinct artifacts.

records.title: Multi-Format Quantization Artifact Isolation
records.independent_classification_reason: Reflects repository folder layout (e.g., separate branches/subfolders for GGUF, EXL2, AWQ). Useful repo-level observation, not universal algorithmic code pattern.
records.technical_problem: Packaging multiple incompatible quantization formats in a single directory confuses automated downloaders.
records.demonstrated_root_cause: Colliding filename conventions across different quantization engines.
records.why_it_works: Directory or branch isolation ensures package managers only pull desired format files.
records.negative_constraints: Do not mix conflicting weight formats in the root distribution directory.

records.title: Quantization Format Compatibility Mapping
records.independent_classification_reason: Model card compatibility table mapping Ollama/LMStudio/ComfyUI versions. Descriptive markdown metadata, not a programmatic Brain rule.
records.technical_problem: Users attempt to run GGUF weights on unsupported inference runners.
records.demonstrated_root_cause: Runner engine feature disparities across versions.
records.why_it_works: Compatibility matrix guides end users to compatible runner versions.
records.negative_constraints: Do not claim universal compatibility without version-pinned matrices.
records.trade_offs_limitations: Requires manual updates as software versions evolve.

records.title: Memory Footprint vs. Quality Threshold Enforcement
records.independent_classification_reason: No automated enforcement script or code diff exists in local dossier. Inferred from quantization size recommendations.
records.technical_problem: Deploying sub-optimal quantization that violates minimum acceptable quality metrics.
records.demonstrated_root_cause: Excessive quantization noise degrading downstream image generation fidelity.
records.why_it_works: Enforcing quality floor prevents release of broken ultra-quantized artifacts.

records.title: Quantization Precision-Size Trade-off Documentation
records.independent_classification_reason: Markdown table documenting file size vs BPW (bits per weight) for Qwen-Image model. Factual repository documentation, routed to 07_PROJECT_LEARNING.
records.technical_problem: Users unable to estimate disk/RAM download requirements.
records.demonstrated_root_cause: Lack of explicit size metrics per quantization tier.
records.why_it_works: Comprehensive documentation enables informed hardware selection.
records.negative_constraints: Do not publish quantized models without exact file byte size tables.

records.title: Tokenizer Special Token Normalization Boundary
records.independent_classification_reason: Dossier Section 3 explicitly details tokenizer_config.json schema added_tokens_decoder, negative constraint on whitespace stripping, and verification logic. Verified in sandbox fixture.
records.technical_problem: Normalization pipeline strips whitespace or mutates casing on special control tokens (<s>, </s>), corrupting model sequence boundary detection.
records.demonstrated_root_cause: Setting normalized=true on control tokens causes tokenizer normalizer to modify string before ID lookup.
records.why_it_works: Enforcing normalized=false preserves exact raw control tokens; allowing normalized=true only for structural markers like </think>.
records.negative_constraints: Special tokens (BOS, EOS, PAD) MUST have normalized: false.
records.cross_repo_applicability: UNIVERSAL (Applies to all Hugging Face tokenizers and custom BPE tokenizers).
